source_request: 시각 의미 데이터화 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 5개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: Build one independently randomized, photographically testable embarrassment repair display in a complex but harmless adult public-work scene, use the attached image solely as the main subject's appearance and visible-identity reference, generate one image, and judge observable pixels rather than infer private psychology.
subject: the adult woman from the attached reference image, appearing as the lead paper conservator, with one clearly adult museum colleague
setting: a public maritime-museum paper-conservation demonstration at a waist-high archival worktable
event: she re-stacks the scattered acid-free catalog cards into their labeled archival tray in correct order while the colleague returns the last card
visual_priorities: her head remains slightly dipped from a brief gaze break while her eyes return to the adult colleague beside her; she wears a small closed-lip smile, the back of two fingers briefly touching one cheek
the colleague crouches to return the last card, meeting her returning glance with an accepting nod and an open helping hand
baseline_prompt_en: Create a photorealistic editorial documentary photograph of the adult woman from the attached reference image as the lead paper conservator during a public maritime-museum demonstration. Use the attached reference only for her facial appearance, hair, and visible identity. At a waist-high conservation table, a harmless sleeve bump has scattered lightweight acid-free catalog cards and two color-reference strips across the tabletop and clean floor. Capture the embarrassment repair display at the restitution phase: her head remains slightly dipped from a brief gaze break while her eyes return to the adult colleague beside her; she wears a small closed-lip smile, the back of two fingers briefly touching one cheek. With her other hand she re-stacks the scattered acid-free catalog cards into their labeled archival tray in correct order. The colleague crouches to return the last card, meeting her returning glance with an accepting nod and an open helping hand. Cool museum skylight mixes with a warm task lamp, revealing paper fibers, archival tools, and the public gallery beyond. Natural skin texture, believable hand contact, clear faces and cards, one coherent candid moment.
